title: 第7章
content_zh: 第七章 准备闭关“这…这是什么契约？”绿桃目瞪口呆，说不出话来，因为那契约阵法是她从未见过的一种。过了大约十多分钟之后，那华丽复杂的紫色契约阵法才慢慢消失，冷若雪双手举着那黑色的小兽，美丽的双眸闪烁着熊熊的怒焰，狠狠地瞪着那小东西，恨不得在它那小身板上瞪出个窟窿，可是那小兽却用着它那萌的可爱的小模样，水汪汪的碧蓝色大眼睛，无辜又可怜兮兮地注视着她，泪水则不停地在眼眶里打转转。又在装可怜，冷若雪更怒了，它要不是一只小兽，冷若雪非掐死它不可，可是她对人可以冷血，对于动物却是一向都很有爱心的，所以，她还真是下不了手。“姐姐，姐姐，呜呜呜…姐姐好凶！”冷若雪的耳边想起了一个稚嫩的男音。“是你在说话？”冷若雪狐疑地看着面前的小兽，因为一般灵兽契约之后都是叫主人的。“和姐姐契约之后宝宝就可以说话了。”黑色小兽委屈地点点头，一脸无辜的看着冷若雪。“不许在用这种表情看着我！”冷若雪眸中那名为愤怒的火焰，燃烧的更盛。“说，为什么未经我同意就擅自契约？”冷若雪脸上挂满了寒霜，她讨厌这种被算计逼迫的感觉。“宝宝，宝宝，喜欢姐姐。”小兽那毛绒绒的兽脸上居然露出了害羞的神情。“喜欢我你就硬来啊…”冷若雪真是无语问苍天啊，这都什么事啊，还有刚刚那个契约‘灵魂本命契约’，她怎么没听说过？她所知道的契约只有两种，平等契约：签订契约的双方如朋友般地位平等，不能强迫，如果一方受伤死去，另一方也不会受到任何伤害；主从契约：这种契约方式是一种强制性的契约方式，主动权掌握在人类的手中，签订契约的双方地位不平等，人类为主，灵兽为从，如果主人死去，灵兽也会死亡，如果灵兽死亡，主人不会受到伤害，这种契约是对灵兽最不公平的一种契约方式，这也是为什么有些骄傲的灵兽宁死也不愿意和人类契约的主要原因，毕竟天下间是没有几个人类会愿意和灵兽签订平等契约的，不过也正是因为有了主从契约，驯兽师的地位才越来越高。“你刚刚和我签订的是什么契约？”她可是还记得契约的时候那个声音说的‘灵魂相随，生命同享，同生共死’，这种契约并不在她已知的范围内。“是灵魂本命契约，宝宝永远都会和姐姐在一起，永远都不会离开姐姐的。”小兽开心地道。“……”“那我要是死了呢？”“那宝宝也会死，姐姐生，宝宝生，姐姐死，宝宝也会跟着死，宝宝永远不会离开姐姐的。”“……”等等，啥叫永远不会离开她？……不会是她想的那样吧，这小东西是打算赖上她吗？这一世还不够？还要生生世世都跟着她？是这个意思吧！冷若雪有些不淡定了，这什么破契约啊，怎么这么霸道，而且契约也已经成立了，她想拒绝都没机会了，只能认了，不但如此，她还得保护好这个看上去没有一点攻击力的小东西，免得它挂了，自己也跟着玩完了。“你哪学的这个契约？”冷若雪很好奇，这个契约并不在人们的认知范围内，可是一个小兽居然会，还算计了她，想到这，冷若雪的气就不打一处来。“宝宝也不知道，宝宝出生的时候就会的。”小兽知道自己惹它喜欢的姐姐生气了，所以有些小心翼翼地，水水的大眼睛还时不时地偷瞄下冷若雪。“……”冷若雪算是看出来了，这就是一个未成年儿童，问了也和没问一样，啥也不知道。“宝宝是你的名字？”冷若雪听到它叫自己宝宝。名为宝宝的小兽点点头，碧蓝色水汪汪的大眼睛依恋地看着冷若雪。冷若雪若有所思的看着面前的小兽，难道这个小家伙不是低阶灵兽？据她所知，只有开了灵智的高级灵兽才会给自己取名字，而低阶灵兽可是没有那个智商的，不过料想这个小东西也不知道自己是什么样的灵兽，所以她也就不问了，反正总有一天会知道的。“那以后姐姐就叫你宝宝吧！”冷若雪道，算是认下了这个弟弟，毕竟他们现在可是一条绳上的。“小姐，老爷回来了。”“知道了。”正在逗弄宝宝的冷若雪站起身，朝着听雪轩的方向走去，回到房间，就看到自己的爷爷正满脸得意地坐在椅子上，吃着她事先让人准备好的糕点。“雪儿，快过来。”冷擎天一看到冷若雪进来，就迫不及待地给她讲起了自己在皇宫中的表现。冷若雪一边给爷爷添着茶水，一边静静地听着，其实就算爷爷不和她说，她也猜得出来皇帝会气成什么样，尤其是退婚这事，最受皇帝宠爱的七皇子被一个傻子把婚退了，这话传出去可不好听啊！“爷爷，我打算闭关。”耐心的听冷擎天讲完，冷若雪突然道她想要学习的东西实在太多了，而且她现在也太弱了，大灵师在普通人的心目中或许已经算是个强者了，可是对她来说却远远不够，她希望自己能够尽快突破大灵师，进阶为灵王，因为只有成为灵王才相当于一只脚踏进了强者的门槛，从大灵师到灵王虽然看似只有一阶，可是却不是那么容易突破的，由古至今，不知道有多少灵师卡在了大灵师上，除非是一些顶级家族才有可能通过丹药来帮助突破，可是那是只有家族中的精英才能够享受得到的，资质普通的弟子是没有那个资格的，而且只有进阶为灵王，才能够学习高级灵技，那也是她最为感兴趣的。“爷爷支持你。”冷擎天见自己的宝贝孙女如此用功，其实是很高兴的，也感到很欣慰，要知道，他们冷家虽然人少，可是却从来没有弱者，他只是有些舍不得，太久见不到自己的孙女罢了。“雪儿，这个给你。”冷擎天拿出一个储物戒指递给自己的孙女。“这里面有这次去皇宫打劫回来的药材，还有这么多年爷爷收集的各系灵技，不过除了火系和风系外，其它的都只有初级和中级”唉，他也没想到他们冷家居然会出了一个拥有全系灵力属性的小变态，昨天他用测试水晶给雪儿测试完的时候可是吓了一大跳的，因为雪儿这天赋实在是太变态了，不但拥用全系灵力属性，而且灵力的亲和力是超等以上的，甚至于精神力也是超等以上，他当时就懵了，因为这意味着他们冷家将会出现一位集灵师、丹师、器师以及驯兽师职业于一身的变态。菱风大陆的历史悠久，但是在历史上还从未出现过集四种职业于一身之人，也许正是鱼与熊掌不能兼得吧，灵师未必会成为器师、丹师、驯兽师，可是器师、丹师、驯兽师则必须首先成为灵师，器师、丹师还要求灵力为火属性，驯兽师则要求灵兽的亲和力为超等，其次精神力至少要达到超等，而对于一个灵师来说，精神力高固然是有好处的，但是对于灵师最重要的并不是精神力，而是灵力的亲和力，亲和力越高，那么这个人将来的成就越大，也就是说，即使是火属性的灵师，如果灵力亲和力为超等，精神力达不到超等，也是不可能成为丹师、器师的，而精神力超等，灵力亲和力达不到超等的丹师、器师也是无法成为一个强大的灵师的。灵力是火属性，亲和力超等以上，精神力超等以上这样的变态，除非是属于某个顶级势力，或是得到某个顶级势力的庇护，否则各大势力是决不会允许其成长起来的，而他在想到这种情况之后，就马上告诉雪儿在没有绝对实力之前不可让任何人知道她的天赋。冷若雪从爷爷手中接过储物戒指，认了主，然后又做了一些闭关前的准备，在前往密室闭关前，看了看恋恋不舍地宝宝，有些无奈。“宝宝，姐姐要闭关了，你乖乖的，不许淘气，知道吗？”“姐姐…你要快点出来啊，宝宝会想你的！”宝宝泪汪汪地说道。“嗯，爷爷，我去了。”“雪儿，爷爷也会想你的！”冷擎天哪能让一个小兽抢走了他的宝贝孙女的关注，连忙道。冷若雪没想到爷爷居然和一只小灵兽争宠，不由得有些好笑，短暂的分离之情也减淡不少，告别之后，便朝着密室内走去。
content_en: Chapter 7 Preparing for Retreat "What...what kind of contract is this?" Lu Tao was stunned and speechless, because the contract formation was something she had never seen before. After about ten minutes, the gorgeous and complicated purple contract formation slowly disappeared. Leng Ruoxue held up the little black beast with both hands, her beautiful eyes flashing with blazing anger, staring at the little thing fiercely, wishing to make a hole in its small body, but the little beast looked at her innocently and pitifully with its cute little appearance and big watery blue eyes, while tears kept rolling in its eyes. Pretending to be pitiful again, Leng Ruoxue became even more angry. If it wasn't a little beast, Leng Ruoxue would have strangled it to death. However, she could be cold-blooded towards people, but she had always been very loving towards animals, so she really couldn't do it. "Sister, sister, wuwuwu...sister is so fierce!" Leng Ruoxue thought of a young male voice in her ears. "Are you talking?" Leng Ruoxue looked at the little beast in front of her suspiciously, because generally spirit beasts call their master after making a contract. "After making a contract with sister, the baby can talk." The little black beast nodded aggrievedly and looked at Leng Ruoxue with an innocent face. "Don't look at me with this expression!" The flame called anger in Leng Ruoxue's eyes burned even more intensely. "Tell me, why did you contract without my consent?" Leng Ruoxue's face was covered with frost. She hated the feeling of being forced by calculations. "Baby, baby, I like my sister." There was a shy look on the little beast's furry face. "If you like me, just do it..." Leng Ruoxue was really speechless and asked the heavens, what is this, and the contract just now, the "soul contract", why hasn't she heard of it? There are only two kinds of contracts she knows. The equality contract: the two parties who signed the contract have equal status like friends and cannot be forced. If one party is injured and dies, the other party will not be harmed in any way; the master-slave contract: this contract method is a mandatory contract method. The initiative is in the hands of humans. The status of the two parties signing the contract is unequal. The human being is the master and the spirit beast is the slave. If the master dies, Spirit beasts will also die. If the spirit beast dies, the owner will not be harmed. This kind of contract is the most unfair contract method to spirit beasts. This is the main reason why some proud spirit beasts would rather die than make a contract with humans. After all, there are few humans in the world who are willing to sign an equal contract with spirit beasts. However, it is precisely because of the master-slave contract that the status of animal trainers is getting higher and higher. "What contract did you just sign with me?" But she still remembered the voice that said during the contract, 'souls, lives, life and death together.' This kind of contract was not within the scope of her knowledge. "It's a soul contract. The baby will always be with the sister and will never leave the sister." The little beast said happily. "..." "Then what if I die?" "Then the baby will also die. If my sister is born, the baby will be born, if my sister dies, the baby will also die. The baby will never leave my sister." "..." Wait, what do you mean it will never leave her? ...It can't be what she thinks. Is this little thing planning to rely on her? Isn’t this life enough? Do you want to follow her for the rest of your life? That’s what it means! Leng Ruoxue was a little uneasy. What kind of broken contract was this? How could she be so overbearing? Moreover, the contract had been established. She had no chance to refuse, so she had to accept it. Not only that, she also had to protect this little thing that seemed to have no offensive power, lest it die and she would end the fun. "Where did you learn this contract?" Leng Ruoxue was curious. This contract was not within the scope of people's knowledge, but a little beast actually knew it and plotted against her. Thinking of this, Leng Ruoxue became angry. "The baby doesn't know either. It will happen when the baby is born." The little beast knew that he had made the sister it liked angry, so he was a little cautious, and his big watery eyes would peek at Leng Ruoxue from time to time. "..." Leng Ruoxue finally figured out that this was an underage child. Even if he asked, it was as if he hadn't asked. He didn't know anything. "Baby, is your name?" Leng Ruoxue heard it calling her baby. The little beast named Baobao nodded, looking at Leng Ruoxue with his big blue watery eyes. Leng Ruoxue looked at the little beast in front of her thoughtfully. Isn't this little guy a low-level spiritual beast? As far as she knew, only high-level spiritual beasts with spiritual intelligence would give themselves names, and low-level spiritual beasts did not have that IQ. However, she expected that this little thing didn't know what kind of spiritual beast he was, so she didn't ask. Anyway, he would know one day. "Then let me call you baby from now on!" Leng Ruoxue said, finally recognizing this younger brother. After all, they are now on the same side. "Miss, the master is back." "I got it." Leng Ruoxue, who was teasing the baby, stood up and walked in the direction of Ting Xuexuan. When she returned to the room, she saw her grandpa sitting on the chair with a proud face, eating the pastries she had prepared in advance. "Xue'er, come here quickly." As soon as Leng Qingtian saw Leng Ruoxue coming in, he couldn't wait to tell her about his performance in the palace. Leng Ruoxue was refilling her grandfather's tea and listening quietly. In fact, even if her grandfather didn't tell her, she could guess how angry the emperor would be, especially the matter of breaking off the engagement. The seventh prince who was most favored by the emperor had his engagement broken off by a fool. It wouldn't be nice to hear this! "Grandpa, I plan to retreat." Listening patiently to Leng Qingtian's words, Leng Ruoxue suddenly said that there were too many things she wanted to learn, and she was too weak now. The Great Spiritual Master might already be considered a strong person in the minds of ordinary people, but it was far from enough for her. She hoped that she could break through the Great Spiritual Master as soon as possible and advance to the level of a spirit.
